programme.desc: Witness the ultimate battle for dominance as scientists try to pick out the alpha male in a pack of 100-plus great white sharks off the New Zealand coast. Marvel at the speed, hunting prowess, and fearlessness that determine the leader of the pack.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway
programme.desc: Embark on a dangerous tagging mission in South Australia that will show what sharks eat and why they gather in feeding hot spots. Then head north as a team chases tiger, bull, and hammerhead sharks and outfits one with a 360-degree dorsal camera.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway
programme.desc: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway
programme.desc: Stay up late as the northern team attaches an activity tag to a bull shark and finds out what this night owl does after sunset. Then dive 80 meters deep with the southern team, who are hoping to put a satellite tracker on a female great white.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway
programme.desc: Ponder shark community hierarchies as the northern team studies how young blacktips learn social and survival skills. Then rush to Rainbow Beach with the southern team, who are eager to witness the sand tiger shark's most elusive behaviour: mating.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway
programme.desc: Travel to the ends of Australia's shark highways. Find out if Greenly Island in the south is a truck stop for migrating great whites, then search for proof of a genetic connection between northern bull sharks and their cooler-climate cousins.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway
programme.desc: Follow the southern team as they test new migration tech and tools that could reduce shark attacks in a popular snorkelling spot. Then catch and tag bull sharks with the northern team, who want to help local swimmers steer clear of birthing mothers.

programme.desc: Welcome to India - a land of exotic animals and exotic warfare. Monkeys stage dusty dust-ups, blackbucks wage open war on the open plains, and peacock dandies swing switchblades: these are colorful battles worthy of a vibrant land.

programme.title: Kenya Wildlife Diaries
programme.desc: Elephant hunting has been banned in Kenya for 40 years. Organized gangs of armed poachers are still targeting elephants, illegally hunting them and selling their ivory tusks on the black market. Environmentalists and conservationists are sounding the alarm.

programme.title: Kingdom Of The Tide
programme.desc: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. It's a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat. Creatures here have evolved in countless bizarre ways. Scientists explore this alien realm.

programme.title: Wild Rockies
programme.desc: Where the mountains cross international borders, herds of elk and moose live side by side with predators like bears and wolves. The predator/prey relationship is a delicate balance, and the perfect place to see it in action is the Kootenay area of the Rocky Mountains.

programme.title: Wild Rockies
programme.desc: The air is thin and cold, trees can't even live here -­- it's not exactly a welcoming place to live. But animals like mountain goats and bighorn sheep and even black bears manage to skitter around these peaks with ease. We'll take a look at how these creatures manage to defy gravity, among some of the highest peaks on the continent.

programme.title: Wild Rockies
programme.desc: Some of mightiest rivers in North America originate on the glacial heights of the Rocky Mountains. The lakes, rivers and marshes of the Rockies are like arteries pulsing through the landscape, feeding the creatures that call the mountains home. Fed by glaciers and motivated by gravity, these waterways are split by the massive Rockies, which divert flow into the Atlantic, Pacific, and Arctic Oceans. From the uninhabitable icy pecks, water melts off glaciers, runs down thunderous waterfalls, filters through wetlands, sculpts the terrain, and finally flows out to the ocean, sustaining life and transforming environments along the way.

programme.title: Wild Rockies
programme.desc: Survival in the forest means maintaining a delicate balance between growth and destruction and death and rebirth - a forest should be in a constant state of regeneration. When trees get too tall they block all the sunlight from hitting the ground, which means grasses and smaller shrubs can't grow, diminishing habitat for animals like elk, moose, caribou, and wolves.

programme.title: Wild Rockies
programme.desc: For a great many species, the structures of group living are the most important for survival. Although social living is integral to many of the animals that call the Rocky Mountains home, no two species organize their society in the same way. Even among closely related species there can be drastic differences in social structure; communication, hierarchy, mating, and diet are all inextricably informed by specific environmental and genetic adaptations for group survival.

programme.title: Tales From Zambia
programme.desc: Zambia's Luangwa Valley is home to Africa's biggest and most fearsome giants, but what really makes it special are its birds. There are over 400 different species here; each perfectly adapted to exploit every opportunity on offer.

programme.title: Tales From Zambia
programme.desc: Africa is a continent filled with unique and extraordinary creatures whose lives are shaped by millions of years of evolution. Africa is also the birthplace of humankind. We traveled alongside the continent's animals on our own journey of evolution, yet intelligence took us on a very different path. Our curiosity led to questions about the world around us which were answered through stories, myths and legends.

programme.title: Tales From Zambia
programme.desc: Chilema is an Elephant with half a trunk; losing the tip to a poacher's snare. It was intended to catch antelope for bushmeat. But the snare's indiscriminate nature means other animals often fall foul of them, with devastating results. Chilema is now having to adapt to life without an elephants most important appendage. She must learn how to eat, drink and also take a mud bath to ensure her survival. With the added challenge of the harsh dry season, Chilema is fighting against the odds to survive.

programme.title: Tales From Zambia
programme.desc: Trees are Africa's oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals help these trees to reproduce by pollinating their flowers and dispersing their seed. African trees promote life, and form the backbone of one of Earths' most precious ecosystems.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: After Olivia and Dad spend an afternoon reading superhero comic books, a toy of William's suddenly goes missing! Could it be the evil doings of some evil super villain? To get William's toy back, Olivia recruits her friends to form her own crimesolving, superhero team!

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia can't wait to see an upcoming meteor shower - she even convinces Mom and Dad to let her stay up late to watch it. Olivia excitedly begins plans to make a family evening out of it, but Mom, Dad and Ian keep falling asleep! Olivia has to find new and creative ways to keep them awake so they don't miss the show!

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: The big school talent show is coming up, and Olivia is looking forward to wowing the crowd with her drum playing. But moments before she's scheduled to take the stage, her drum kit is accidentally destroyed! Olivia has to think fast, drumming on trash cans and other items in a rousing “Stomp”-like performance!

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: Cappy's Mail Order Eyes - Casper and his friends order some new eyes for Cappy's birthday present. Cappy's delighted until he pops them in and finds the world is TRULY horrifying. Cappy is so terrified he runs away to Deedstown. The little monsters suddenly realise that they've ordered Sea Monkey eyes by mistake! Casper has to get Cappy AND the eyes back before Cappy loses his marbles completely. Pumpkin Pal - Poor old Pumkinhead. Thatch has been teasing him for having an 'imaginary friend'. Casper, Ra and Mantha decide to help him find a new friend but soon find themselves wishing they'd listened better in Professor Burns's class when the potion they use creates a real 'friend' rather larger and more terrifying than they'd bargained for.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: The Day the Professor Croaked - Professor Burns wants a day off. Casper tries to help by pretending that Mosshead's pet toad IS the professor, temporarily changed in form. But today is a big inspection day - Kibosh is on his way to grade the teachers and that toad's going to have to teach class or else! A Potent Brew - Casper's uncle Stinky gets sucked into one of Jimmy's dad Graham's crazy monster catching gadgets - a tea pot - ALONGWITH Graham himself. And they can't get out. The more they panic the more the teapot bounces out of control. Casper and Jimmy have to catch the teapot and work out how to open it before the light hits red and they are locked in there forever.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries
programme.desc: When Harper unknowingly drops her cooking camp application on the way to post office, it's up to the Dew Drops to get it into that big blue mailbox. / When Cassie accidentally places Lola's beloved, old toy wand in a box marked for a giveaway drive in the park, the Dew Drops must find a way to retrieve the wand before it ends up in the hands of an entirely new family.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries
programme.desc: Marcus has a piano recital and unknowingly forgets his lucky penny at home. Now it's up to the Dew Drops to get the penny across town and back into Marcus' pocket before showtime. / When Nicholas rolls the hamster ball (with Hammy inside) out into the streets, the Dew Drops must get Hammy back home safely.

programme.desc: Kelp and Scallop enlist Cruz's help to perform a dance for Mom's birthday. programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild
programme.desc: Melman finds a lucky flower and is convinced that today will be his Best Day Ever! But when a series of unlucky events threaten to ruin his day, he's faced with the choice to drown in his sorrows or “take back the day”!

Tiba-tiba pekerja am Sean dan Beber diangkat menjadi pengurus segera kerana mereka yang paling lama berkhidmat di Damai Beach Resort selain Kak Maggie yang sudah amnesia. Sean dan Beber mempunyai dua sikap yang berbeza namun mereka perlu bersama-sama menjadi pengurus hotel untuk menyelamatkan hotel tersebut sementara menunggu kepulangan Tuan Rudi dan mendapatkan gaji mereka yang tertunggak. Kak Maggie seorang wanita cina yang buat kerja seperti sloth tetapi tahu tentang semua kedudukan kewangan hotel. Tuan Rudi pula telah melarikan diri kerana dia dikejar oleh Ah Long kerana tidak mampu membayar hutang.

Tiba-tiba pekerja am Sean dan Beber diangkat menjadi pengurus segera kerana mereka yang paling lama berkhidmat di Damai Beach Resort selain Kak Maggie yang sudah amnesia. Sean dan Beber mempunyai dua sikap yang berbeza namun mereka perlu bersama-sama menjadi pengurus hotel untuk menyelamatkan hotel tersebut sementara menunggu kepulangan Tuan Rudi dan mendapatkan gaji mereka yang tertunggak. Kak Maggie seorang wanita cina yang buat kerja seperti sloth tetapi tahu tentang semua kedudukan kewangan hotel. Tuan Rudi pula telah melarikan diri kerana dia dikejar oleh Ah Long kerana tidak mampu membayar hutang.

programme.desc: Saisamorn Suaisamoe, seorang pelakon terkenal dari keluarga kaya yang bercita-cita besar untuk membintangi sebuah filem. Namun dia tiada pengalaman dalam menjiwai watak yang beremosi cinta. Oleh itu, dia bercadang pergi ke desa Phetchaburi agar boleh mempunyai pengalaman tentang cinta. Di sana Saisamorn tinggal di rumah Marasri. Dia berkenalan dengan Mana dan mengajar Saisamorn cara kehidupan di desa. programme.title: Nyiur Nan Setandan
programme.desc: Kisah keluarga Haji Deris dan Hajah Sutinah penuh rencah kehidupan di kampung. Haji Deris yang keras hati akhirnya insaf mendapatkan rawatan mata selepas tersesat di kebun. Tiga anak mereka turut diuji, Aripin menghadapi kerenah isteri panas baran, Ita bergelut isu zuriat, manakala pertunangan Udin goyah dek gaya hidup mewah Ima.

programme.title: Syahadat Cinta
programme.desc: Sakinah, bekas banduan ini bangkit mengusahakan ladang demi mengubah nasib keluarga di sebalik pelbagai ugutan. Namun, konflik cinta tiga segi tercetus apabila guru anaknya, Cikgu Helmi, meminang Sakinah tanpa menyedari anaknya, Sarah turut meminatinya. Tragedi kematian anak bongsunya kemudian menguji kewarasan Sakinah sehingga dia hilang ingatan.

programme.title: Shendu Fox Detective
programme.desc: Di Luoyang, rentetan pembunuhan yang menyasarkan wanita muda menyebabkan bandar menjadi huru-hara. Pegawai Kuil Dali, Hu Zheng Yi ditugaskan untuk membongkar kebenaran, manakala seniman bela diri muda Li Jian Xing, yang ingin menyelesaikan pembunuhan beramai-ramai keluarganya, mendekati Hu Zheng Yi dengan motif tersembunyi. Lakonan : Yin Xiao Tian, Leo Yang, He Tian Tian, Wen Xi, Fan Meng, Sun Li Han.

programme.title: The Write One
programme.desc: Liam, seorang penulis yang tidak berpuas hati dengan kehidupannya sebagai suami dan bapa. Suatu hari, dia menemui sebuah mesin taip ajaib yang membolehkannya menulis semula hidupnya dan memasuki dunia alternatif. Di dunia baharu itu, Liam dan isterinya Joyce menjalani kehidupan sangat berbeza daripada realiti asal. Namun, perubahan ini memaksa Liam memilih antara mengejar impian atau mempertahankan cinta dan keluarga sebenar. Lakonan : Ruru Madrid, Bianca Umali, Mikee Quintos, Paul Salas dan ramai lagi.

programme.title: You Are My Heartbeat
programme.desc: Sira, seorang ahli perniagaan pengidap mysophobia yang tidak tahan dengan kotoran atau penipuan bertemu dengan Kanghan, seorang pereka fesyen berbakat yang ceria dan berjiwa bebas. Walaupun personaliti mereka bertentangan dan sering berselisih faham, akhirnya, perasaan bertukar menjadi cinta sejati. Lakonan : Puttichai Kasetsin, Davika Hoorne, Jackie Jackrin Kungwankiatichai dan ramai lagi.

Satu hari, Abirami didapati hilang. Maka haru-birulah hidup vellu dan Maragatham. Lakonan : Thangmani, Meena, James Arokiasamy dan ramai lagi.

programme.title: Khabar Dari Casablanca
programme.desc: Datin Amnah kesal dengan tindakan keluarga Farhan yang merahsiakan berita Karima hamil dari pengetahuan Datuk Iskandar. Sharina cuba menenteramkan Karima yang risau dengan kehadiran Datin Amnah dan dia dapat merasakan yang Datin Amnah tidak suka padanya. Datin Amnah nyata kecewa dengan tindakan Farhan membawa pulang Karima bersamanya ke Malaysia sedangkan Nadia sedang sakit ketika itu.

Namun, Paul dan kakitangannya mula ragu akan kesalahan Coffey apabila menyaksikan keajaiban yang dilakukannya seperti menyembuhkan penyakit dan menghidupkan semula hidupan yang telah mati, sekali gus menyedari Coffey memiliki anugerah luar biasa dan mungkin tidak bersalah, lantas memaksa Paul bergelut dengan nilai keadilan, iman dan takdir dalam sistem perundangan yang rumit. programme.title: KONA MAI 2026
programme.desc: Rehatkan minda anda pada penghujung hari bersama Shah, Faruk & Mimie dalam segmen KONA MAI. Segmen ini membawakan pilihan lagu santai, pengisian rohani, serta seleksi lagu-lagu kesukaan anda di Tapaw Lagu @ Kafe Muzik. Sebelum melelapkan mata, nikmati alunan lagu-lagu melankolik terkini, bahasa Melayu, Inggeris, dan Indonesia untuk menemani malam anda dengan penuh kedamaian.

programme.title: GENG PAGI MUTIARA
programme.desc: Mulakan Pagi anda dengan penuh bersemangat bersama Chombi dan Bambam!\\n Segmen ini menyajikan gabungan lengkap untuk memulakan hari anda dengan positif—daripada pengisian rohani menerusi bacaan Al-Quran, nasyid, dan Santai Nurani, hinggalah kepada berita sahih, laporan trafik semasa, tajuk-tajuk akhbar utama, serta topik pagi yang santai dan menghiburkan. Jangan lupa layan lagu-lagu permintaan anda dalam slot Layan Pagi sebelum melangkah ke tengah hari!

programme.title: FOKUS MUTIARA
programme.desc: Sambil buat kerja atau berehat, penyampai kami Azie, Elly , Mimie & Fazrinah sedia menemani dengan pelbagai maklumat berguna dan hiburan menarik. Dapatkan petua serta tips gaya hidup serta pelbagai perkongsian harian yang terkini. Nikmati juga kelainan irama Bollywood menerusi Syoknya Hindi & mengimbau memori menerusi Everlasting Memory dengan lagu retro Inggeris terbaik serta laporan berita Warta Mutiara secara langsung bagi memastikan anda sentiasa peka dengan isu semasa.

programme.title: PETANG KREW
programme.desc: Petang anda pastinya tidak hambar bersama gandingan serasi Amin , Que , Mimie dan Fazrinah! Sambil melayan perjalanan pulang dari kerja, dapatkan pengisian Mutiara Ilmu, tips keusahawanan dalam Biz On Air, serta bincangkan pelbagai Isu hangat dan menarik menerusi Ralet Cheq. Tak lengkap petang anda tanpa menguji minda dalam peraduan Teka Tiara Nyanyi bersama kemaskini trafik dan berita terkini.

programme.title: PELET PEGHELIH
programme.desc: Pelet Peghelīh merupakan segmen santai yang dekat dengan masyarakat Perlis, menampilkan kisah kehidupan harian, pengalaman penduduk tempatan, serta cerita-cerita menarik yang mencerminkan budaya dan gaya hidup orang Perlis. Disampaikan secara bersahaja bersama DJ Bella dan tetamu jemputan Cik Krie & Faiz Skyfield, segmen ini menghiburkan sambil mengangkat suara dan identiti komuniti setempat.

programme.title: SANTAI 5-8
programme.desc: Segmen Santai 5-8 mengandungi zon muzik segmen Lagu 60 an pada Isnin Laguku Kuasa Dua pada Selasa Rabu Lagu dan Kenangan Khamis Secangkir Bicara/Nurul Al-Quran dan Jumaat La Khobar. Sabtu dan Ahad segmen Hello Hello MELAKAfm pilihan lagu dan ucapan pendengar

programme.title: GEGAU PAGI 6-10
programme.desc: Seri Pagi dimulakan dengan Bacaan Al-Quran & Terjemahan seterusnya rancangan Permata Hati dan Kapsul Motivasi Jana Minda. Info Cuaca dan Berita MELAKAfm. Info trafik(call out) dan Topik Gegau Pagi interaktif bersama pendengar.Kokenut Shake Dulu Special (Temubual/Zon Iklan menyusul selepasnya. Pada Hari Sabtu pula rancangan Yok Donga Be bersiaran melibatkan tiga negeri Zon Selatan iaitu Melaka, Negeri Sembilan dan Johor secara interaktif. Sementara pada Hari Ahad Mari Berpantun(interaktif)seni budaya warisan kita.

programme.title: Pesona 10-2
programme.desc: Pendengar berpeluang memberi ucapan kepada orang yang tersayang dan membuat permintaan lagu menerusi ruangan Laguku Untukmu, bermula jam 11 pagi. Turut disajikan rancangan Dialog 1:30, program temu bual bersama Jabatan Kerajaan dan agensi-agensi berkaitan dengan memfokuskan topik-topik berkaitan situasi semasa. Rancangan keagamaan seperti Mutiara Ilmu, Fiqh Nisa dan Dari Kamar Syariah pula diserikan pada setiap Jumaat.

programme.title: Panorama 2-5
programme.desc: Santai bersama lagu-lagu tempatan dan antarabangsa terbaik menerusi ruangan 'Zon Muzik setiap Isnin jam 3 petang. Pada setiap Selasa, info-info menarik mengenai kenderaan dikongsikan menerusi rancangan 'Vromm??'. Pendengar juga akan menikmati keindahan warisan budaya negeri Melaka menerusi 'Dondang Sayang' jam 3 petang, Rabu dan 'Persada Pantun' jam 3 petang, Khamis. Turut disajikan rancangan keagamaan seperti 'Secangkir Bicara: Biar Santai Janji Sampai' dan 'Nurul Quran' \"La khobar\"pada setiap Jumaat. Sabtu dan Ahad diserikan dengan Silang Budaya/Stesen Berkembar Suara Bertemu Suara Satu Suara Satu Jiwa.

programme.title: Relaks Mfm 8-12
programme.desc: Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan Santai Buskers dan juga Dari Studio Muzik. Seleksi lagu-lagu ketuhanan melayari Khamis malam Jumaat anda. Turut Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan rancangan IN-TREND pilihan lagu-lagu baru. Seleksi lagu-lagu dalam Senada Duet melayari malam Khamis anda Malam Bunga Bunga Cinta untuk yang curhat pada malam Jumaat bersama DJ Ain. Turut disajikan 'Waronk Dangdut pada Sabtu dan Syok 80-90 pada Ahad.

Seleksi lagu-lagu ketuhanan melayari Khamis malam Jumaat anda. Turut Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan rancangan IN-TREND pilihan lagu-lagu baru. programme.title: Pesona 10-2
programme.desc: Pendengar berpeluang memberi ucapan kepada orang yang tersayang dan membuat permintaan lagu menerusi ruangan Laguku Untukmu, bermula jam 11 pagi. programme.title: Berita Jam 5 petang-Nasionalfm, Angkasapuri Kuala Lumpur
RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.

programme.desc: 叮！下班铃声响起，属于你自己的时间正式开始。《下班开麦啦》是你在晚高峰通勤路上最懂你的“解压陪伴站”。告别繁琐的工作汇报和烦人的KPI，这里只有轻松搞笑的职场吐槽、热辣接地气的社会热议，以及最治愈的音乐与故事。无论你正挤在拥挤的地铁里，还是堵在回家的车流中，戴上耳机，和我们一起开麦畅聊，把一天的疲惫一扫而空！

programme.title: 听歌好时光
programme.desc: 忙碌的生活里，你有多久没有好好听完一首歌了？这里是《听歌好时光》，你的私享音乐会客厅。我们不设复杂的门槛，没有沉重的叙事，只挑选最惬意、最动听的旋律，为你揉碎日常的喧嚣。沏一杯清茶，或是斟一杯咖啡，在这个专属的空间里，让我们用好歌慢下来，静静享受属于你的好时光。

programme.title: 说一惠儿
programme.desc: 生活太忙，话题太重？不如停下脚步，和淑惠一起“说一会儿”。这里是《Talk with Hui 说一惠儿》，一个没有说教、不设门槛的声音客厅。每期节目，主播惠都会邀请有趣的朋友做客，或是独自坐下，聊聊日常里的奇思妙想、职场上的酸甜苦辣，以及那些打动内心的瞬间。一杯茶，麦克风前，我们今天就轻松地“说一惠儿”！

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah for a land, sea and space extravaganza! First, she boards the Intrepid aircraft carrier for an air and sea adventure! She explores an airplane, a helicopter and learns about life as a sailor. Then, 3-2-1 Blast Off! Astronaut Meekah zooms around the Columbia Memorial Space Center. She builds a model of Apollo 11, watches a parachute sail to the ground, programs a Mars Rover and makes gooey slime for Blippi!

programme.title: Blippi's Ultimate Playdates
programme.desc: Join Blippi for ultimate playdates full of action! First, Blippi and Everest play a vehicle scavenger hunt at an indoor playground, learning about teamwork. Then, get ready to rock out with Miles Music Kid for a remix of 'Curious Like Me' and an awesome dance party! The fun continues in the Fun Food Kitchen for the Mystery Box Food Challenge, where they guess wacky foods just by touching them!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi for two of his biggest challenges ever! First, Blippi wants to create the ultimate ball pit by filling a giant bouncy castle with thousands of balls in the silliest way possible! Then, for his 10th Anniversary, Blippi celebrates with a trip to a candy escape room. He and his friends must solve silly challenges and beat the clock, or a delicious dessert prize will get squished by a real excavator! Can they finish in time?

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: Blippi watches along to clips of his top 10 favorite episodes about dinosaurs. He roars, stomps, wiggles, and giggles his way through all things dinosaur! Countdown with him through egg hunts, fossil digs, and dinosaur chases...ROARRRR!

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: Blippi watches along to clips of his top 10 favorite ANIMAL episodes! He meets new animal friends like cheetahs, reindeer, and even sting rays and gets to play and feed some of them, too! Count down with him to number 1!

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: Racecars, firetrucks, construction vehicles... oh my! Blippi loves learning about vehicles of all shapes and sizes, so he's excited to share his top ten moments in a vehicle! From go-karts to rocketships, and even a Monster Jam truck, these are his favorite vehicle adventures!

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: Time for some indoor fun! Blippi is sharing his top 10 favorite visits to amazing indoor playgrounds. Relive the excitement as he explores giant play structures, jumps in colorful ball pits, and zips down super-fast slides. It's a high-energy collection of his most memorable indoor adventures.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is answering some of life's biggest questions! He shrinks down for a night adventure in a mouth to learn the right way to brush teeth from Bill Brushy. Then, he flies up a nose to find out what makes us sneeze! His curiosity continues as he learns how a fly can walk upside down on the ceiling, discovers the artistic process of how spiders make their webs and even becomes a contestant on a game show to learn the difference between fruits and vegetables!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: It's time for Blippi to get curious and creative! A mysterious book appears in the clubhouse, and when Blippi opens it, the brand-new Curiosity Crew jumps out! After helping the crew figure out what they're looking for (popsicles!), Blippi and Meekah join them on some creative adventures. They learn all about how to mix colors to make a beautiful rainbow painting, shrink down to dance with Bendjamin the Klutz and ride a library cart on a hunt for books about dinosaurs!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is answering some of life's biggest questions! He shrinks down for a night adventure in a mouth to learn the right way to brush teeth from Bill Brushy. Then, he flies up a nose to find out what makes us sneeze! His curiosity continues as he learns how a fly can walk upside down on the ceiling, discovers the artistic process of how spiders make their webs and even becomes a contestant on a game show to learn the difference between fruits and vegetables!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Get ready for a wild ride of random antiks with Joey and Boo! The adventure begins when they take a leaf for a boat ride but get chased by a hungry fish. Then, they struggle to move a giant piece of candy until they eat some of it, giving them super speed! The random fun continues as Boo falls into a pot of invisible ink, they find a house made of gingerbread that a spider also wants and they discover a tiny toy racecar that takes them on a wild ride they can't control!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Join Joey and Boo in a series of adventures where everything goes wrong! First, Joey plans the perfect birthday party for Boo, only to forget her present at the last minute! Then, when Boo gets sick, Joey must go on an arduous journey for soup ingredients. The bad luck continues as Joey gets stuck to the back of a spider, they get encased in cement while chasing a berry and they are accidentally rolled up inside a meatball by a dung beetle!

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: Get ready for a big day of teamwork and rescues at T-Rex Ranch! Tara and Asher are all set for a game of soccer, but a playful pterodactyl swoops in and snatches their ball! The two rangers must team up to get it back. Then, the rangers must race against time to find more food for the dinosaurs after Darren accidentally burns their dinner. The day ends with another rescue, as the kids must save Darren when some raptors start chasing him while he's learning to ride a bike!

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: Beware the evil shrink blaster at T-Rex Ranch! First, Park Rangers Aaron and LB receive a mysterious letter from Despicable G, but before they can discover its contents, they must first battle a giant T-Rex! Then, an intruder comes into the T-Rex ranch with a shrink blaster and starts making all the dinosaurs tiny! Can Park Rangers Cam and Darren team up to stop the intruder and save the day?

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: Join the Park Rangers for a fun day at the dinosaur park! Park Rangers LB and Aaron embark on an exciting adventure when a paddock fence collapses. They must quickly work together to repair it to prevent the giant dinosaurs from escaping! Then, the two rangers visit Dinosaur World to check out the massive life-size dinosaurs. Later, they have a fun hide-and-seek challenge among the dinos, competing for a mystery prize. Who will win the thrilling game?

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Join Blippi for some fun nature discoveries! First, he and D.BO dive to the ocean floor to help a forgetful island remember why it doesn't float away. Then, they shrink down for some smaller adventures! They help a firefly find a friend with the same blinking pattern, float high in the sky to learn how bubbles are made and join a group of ants on a mission to find out how they walk in such a straight line. The adventure is full of singing, science and new friends!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is wondering about animals on an ultimate adventure! Join Blippi and his robot friend FETCH as they travel the world to get their questions answered. How high can a kangaroo jump? Blippi finds out in a hopping race in Australia! How do bats see in the dark? A new bat friend shows him all about echolocation! The adventure continues as he learns why squirrels bury nuts and how ducks float. Blippi and FETCH also help their new friends, like when they work together to rebuild a blue jay's nest!

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, and learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok and the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: How does a recycling truck work? What happens on a farm? Will this object Sink or Float? Blippi explores the world around us with silly dance moves, fun songs, and awesome adventures. There is so much to learn about, it will make you want to shout 'BLIPPI'!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: It's time for a super fun day with Blippi and Meekah! First, they head to Adventure City Theme Park to ride the rails, meet furry friends and figure out cool ways to learn and play! Then, get ready for a fall-tastic pumpkin patch playdate! Join the best friends as they jump in big bounce houses, get lost in a corn maze and play pumpkin ring toss and hockey! It's a day full of exciting adventures!

programme.title: Blippi: Specials
programme.desc: How does a recycling truck work? What happens on a farm? Will this object Sink or Float? Blippi explores the world around us with silly dance moves, fun songs, and awesome adventures. There is so much to learn about, it will make you want to shout 'BLIPPI'!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: It's a strange day for the Oddbods! After being caught in one of Bubbles' experiments, Fuse and Newt accidentally switch bodies! As Bubbles searches for a way to reverse it, an over-excitable Fuse enters the now curmudgeonly Newt into a dance competition. Then, Slick goes on an increasingly desperate quest to find a 'Golden Ticket' for an exclusive disco-party. Plus, Slick is determined to look his best for the group photo.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are on the move! When modifications to Fuse's truck cause it to develop a mind of its own and turn truly monstrous, he must take back control to protect his friends. Then, Pogo loses his license after a bout of reckless driving and is horrified to discover that he's got Jeff as his examiner! Plus, when Newt is upstaged by Pogo, she grows determined to become strong herself with some help from Fuse.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The cul-de-sac is dealing with some new arrivals! First, there's an alien invader, in the form of a popcorn-obsessed creature that has cloned itself to look exactly like Newt, who is trapped on its spaceship! Then, Zee has the misfortune of having to babysit his disruptive niece and nephew who seem intent on wrecking both his home and his head! Plus, a pleasant afternoon barbecue takes a turn for the worse for Jeff.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: It's a strange day for the Oddbods! Newt, Jeff and Pogo all go out for the perfect picnic, except each has a separate idea of what that entails! Then, a rogue bear enters Oddsville and the park ranger's tranquilizer darts accidentally hit Zee! It's up to the Oddbods to watch over his sleepwalking antics. Finally, after a moment of humiliation, Pogo and Jeff get into a competitive battle to see who the better clown is.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: Zak's greatest invention, the Shrinkinator, backfires, shrinking him and his grandpa down to the size of bugs! Their new bug-sized life immediately gets more complicated when their very first attempt to find the machine's missing parts leads them straight into a trap. Captured by the menacing mite Adilla, they must now outsmart their captor just to continue their quest to get back to normal.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: The backyard is turned upside down! The Insectibles are baffled when they encounter Hye, a cockroach walking around without a head. As they investigate this spooky mystery, they face an even bigger problem: a gang of crooks disguised as the Insectibles is committing crimes and ruining their reputation. Now, the team must solve the riddle of the headless bug while hunting down their devious doppelgangers to clear their name.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: The adventure begins with a daring rescue as Chowser and Willow save Zak from the clutches of the Ant Queen. But their relief is short-lived when Zak uncovers a sinister secret: the ants plan to make Chowser their next meal! Before they can even recover from that crisis, their quest home is dealt another blow when a giant magpie swoops down and snatches a vital Shrinkinator part. The team must now stage a high-flying heist to steal back their technology from the bird's massive nest.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is wondering, 'How does it work?!' Join Blippi and his robot buddy FETCH on an adventure to find the answers! Blippi shrinks down to fly inside a beehive and learn how honey is made, and explores a garbage truck to find out why flies love it so much. Then, it's a trip through a factory to see how chocolate is made! The adventure even travels through time as Blippi meets his great-grandpa to see the very first cars. Plus, Blippi and FETCH help a nervous crane learn to build a skyscraper!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is on an adventure from dinosaurs to pet knights! He travels back in time with Tabbs to help a little Microraptor prove that being small has its benefits when they rescue a giant sauropod from the mud. Then, they head to the African savannah to learn how to roar, sneak and pounce like a lion! Back at the clubhouse, Blippi learns how to interpret a puppy's tail wags and even travels back in time again to help a real-life knight in shining armor-who happens to be a corgi!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Join Blippi on an adventure to the wonders of our world and beyond! First, he travels to the tallest mountain on Earth, Mt. Everest, with his new friend Betty the Yeti. Then, he dives deep into the ocean to explore a kelp forest with Jerry the Jellyfish. The adventure gets explosive as Blippi and FETCH fly into a volcano! After exploring the Earth, Blippi blasts off into space to tour the solar system, learn about gravity on the moon and discover how rainbows get their amazing colors!

He travels back in time with Tabbs to help a little Microraptor prove that being small has its benefits when they rescue a giant sauropod from the mud. Then, they head to the African savannah to learn how to roar, sneak and pounce like a lion! Back at the clubhouse, Blippi learns how to interpret a puppy's tail wags and even travels back in time again to help a real-life knight in shining armor-who happens to be a corgi!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is wondering, 'How does it work?!' Join Blippi and his robot buddy FETCH on an adventure to find the answers! Blippi shrinks down to fly inside a beehive and learn how honey is made, and explores a garbage truck to find out why flies love it so much. Then, it's a trip through a factory to see how chocolate is made! The adventure even travels through time as Blippi meets his great-grandpa to see the very first cars. Plus, Blippi and FETCH help a nervous crane learn to build a skyscraper!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Get ready for some technological mayhem with the Oddbods! What's more annoying than Pogo? Another Pogo! He finds Bubbles' cloning machine and decides to make a copy of himself for double the pranks. Then, he uses an invisibility device to cause all sorts of havoc in Oddsville, making his neighbors think they're being haunted by ghosts! Plus, Slick orders a robot buddy, but it malfunctions and causes trouble.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some tricky situations! First, Slick receives a knitted hat from Newt that he hates, so he comes up with a plan to 'accidentally' lose it so he doesn't hurt her feelings. Then, Fuse's terrible temper while watching sports gets him in trouble, and he has to try his best to keep a lid on it while watching a game with Newt. The trouble continues when Jeff gets a mysterious itch and blames it on a sleeping Zee!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Join the Antiks on a series of chaotic adventures for delicious food! Whether it's a tantalizing lollipop, a rolling olive, or a crumb from a biscuit, Joey and Boo will do whatever it takes to get it. Their journey is filled with unexpected obstacles, from treacherous sticky tape to menacing fly swatters and even a mind-controlling mushroom. Through teamwork and clever thinking, these tiny heroes face every challenge head-on in a comical pursuit of their next meal.

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Slip and slide through a frozen wonderland, crack open a giant treat, sneak past a strict no ant policy at a Christmas party, decorate a tree with stolen sparkle, and race a magpie for a shiny chocolate coin.

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: Join the Park Rangers for a super silly day of ranger fails! First, Park Ranger Darren accidentally gets his night vision goggles stuck on his head, leaving him unable to see properly. Park Ranger Asher has to step up to be Darren's eyes and ears to guide him! Then, in another silly mishap, Darren accidentally gets hit with a sleepy dart! Can Park Rangers Asher and Naomi find the ingredients for the Wake Up Juice in time?

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: Join the Park Rangers for a super fun day of pranks and rescues! While exploring the ranch, Rangers Tara and Asher stumble upon a series of pranks, including trick eggs bursting with silly spray! But who could be the prankster? Then, it's new Park Ranger Naomi's first day at the ranch! But things go awry when a pterodactyl swoops in and flies away with her important work. Can she find a way to get it back?

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is wondering about animals on an ultimate adventure! Join Blippi and his robot friend FETCH as they travel the world to get their questions answered. How high can a kangaroo jump? Blippi finds out in a hopping race in Australia! How do bats see in the dark? A new bat friend shows him all about echolocation! The adventure continues as he learns why squirrels bury nuts and how ducks float. Blippi and FETCH also help their new friends, like when they work together to rebuild a blue jay's nest!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Join Blippi for some fun nature discoveries! First, he and D.BO dive to the ocean floor to help a forgetful island remember why it doesn't float away. Then, they shrink down for some smaller adventures! They help a firefly find a friend with the same blinking pattern, float high in the sky to learn how bubbles are made and join a group of ants on a mission to find out how they walk in such a straight line. The adventure is full of singing, science and new friends!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is learning awesome facts about all kinds of animals! He and D.BO travel back in time to meet the biggest dinosaurs, like the Argentinosaurus, and even try to keep a T-Rex as a pet for a day! Back in the present, they shrink down to count a shark's teeth with a pilot fish dentist. The adventure continues as Blippi learns how elephants use their trunks to keep cool and discovers why cats have whiskers from a local feline celebrity.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi and Meekah have a blast with a mix of indoor and outdoor fun! They start their day with a bowling ball blast, learning about the game, the special shoes and the shapes found in a bowling alley, complete with a post-game dance break. Then they head to Tree People in the Santa Monica Mountains for a nature walk, learning about trees, making animal crafts and helping tell a story with animal puppets!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi for some fun adventures riding camels and horses! First, Blippi visits a camel farm in the Al Khatim Desert, where he gets to pet, feed and learn all about camels. He even sees some baby camels before going on a fun camel ride across the sand! Then, Blippi goes horseback riding at Dogwood Canyon Nature Park. He meets a new horse friend and learns how to care for and ride horses.

Then, while exploring, Meekah discovers a magic key which unlocks a Storybook Box! The box sets her on a journey to use all her five senses to find a yummy treat!

programme.title: Meekah

It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

programme.desc: The Oddbods are having a summer of fun, learning and camping! Newt discovers that Fuse can't ride a bike because of a childhood trauma, so she kindly offers to teach him. Then, on a sweltering day, Fuse and Zee get into a bickering match over who is last in line for the ice cream van. Finally, Fuse goes camping for some alone time, but his trip is ruined by the arrival of Jeff and all his modern camping conveniences!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are in a real panic! First, Fuse and Pogo find themselves stranded inside Jeff's house after he goes on holiday. They must find a way to get along until Jeff gets back! Then, Fuse is rescued by Newt from an embarrassing situation and takes it upon himself to repay the debt by becoming her hero. Finally, one of Bubbles' experiments ends up in Pogo's ice cream, and his customers start to experience terrible side effects!

programme.desc: A strange ray accidentally zaps Hye and Lo, making them so brilliant that they defy Adilla and begin using their new intellect to help the Insectibles create peace. Their efforts are complicated when Zak mistakes their help for an attack. At the same time, Gramps invents a helmet camera to offer technical support on missions, but his constant stream of advice becomes more of a hindrance than a help, creating chaos from two different sources.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: Lidia discovers a remote that can control Willow's bionic drill, but Adilla quickly snatches it, gaining mind-control over the Insectibles' friend. Before she can use this new power to her advantage, a new crisis emerges. The roaches find a magic 8-ball and declare it their new leader, and its first comm and is to destroy the Shrinkinator. Adilla must now team up with her arch-enemy Zak to save the very machine she has been trying to steal.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: The moment of triumph is here as Gramps and Zak find the final piece of the Shrinkinator! But their celebration is cut short when Adilla captures the entire team. After a daring escape, the Insectibles brace for a final showdown. While Syd rallies the other bugs in the yard for support, Zak, Willow, and Chowser mount a desperate defense of the shed, with Zak facing Adilla one last time to stop her from activating the Shrinkinator and claiming victory.

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Join Joey and Boo in a series of adventures where everything goes wrong! First, Joey plans the perfect birthday party for Boo, only to forget her present at the last minute! Then, when Boo gets sick, Joey must go on an arduous journey for soup ingredients. The bad luck continues as Joey gets stuck to the back of a spider, they get encased in cement while chasing a berry and they are accidentally rolled up inside a meatball by a dung beetle!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Joey and Boo are a pair of losers when their search for food goes wrong. They battle a fly for a pear, get stuck in jelly and ride an out-of-control meatball. They also get trapped inside a worm, get stuck in earwax and deal with a leaky tap. No matter what they do, their simple tasks turn into wild, chaotic adventures.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi on a sense-ational journey! He visits a garden to discover his five senses, exploring the flavors of fruit and colors of flowers. He names all the colors and learns about flowers, picking a beautiful bouquet.

programme.title: Meekah

programme.title: Peter Five Eight
programme.desc: Sam, a seemingly poised and glamorous real estate agent in a small mountain community is revealed to be an unhinged and troubled alcoholic with a dark secret, when a charismatic man in a black sedan named Peter shows up in town one day.

programme.title: High Voltage [Extended Version]
programme.desc: After a lightning strike kills the lead singer of a band, she is resurrected with electrifying special abilities.

programme.title: Tim
programme.desc: A somewhat mentally handicapped 20-year-old man works as a laborer, but everyone abuses his naivety. A nice 40-year-old American woman hires him one day and they become close. However, the town and his family see her as predatory.

programme.title: No One Lives
programme.desc: A gang of ruthless highway killers kidnap a wealthy couple traveling cross country only to shockingly discover that things are not what they seem.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: Based on the true story, Edgar Valdez, drug lord and cartel leader, is betrayed by one of the brothers. Seeking retribution, Valdez will risk it all to gain control of the Feliz cartel.

programme.title: Broadcast
programme.desc: After a billionaire creates a drug called INOC which stops the aging process, the future of a world where death no longer exists is seen. The story of the fate of mankind is told while also revealing an elusive truth to its unknowing spectator.

programme.title: Pocket Listing
programme.desc: Double crosses, adultery, murder, mistaken identity, and revenge ensue when a mysterious power player and his sultry wife hire a disgraced Los Angeles property broker to discreetly market and sell their Malibu villa.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: The Jews of Eastern Europe are being massacred by the thousands. Galvanised into action after the death of his wife, Hungarian barrister Sonson finds himself leading an inspirational fight back against the increasingly desperate and dangerous Nazis.

programme.title: Juvenile
programme.desc: Troublemaker Billy Forsetti falls for the beautiful Jennifer. But when a carjacking takes a turn for the worse, Billy finds himself in for trouble.

programme.title: The Piper
programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American emigres Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelins International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: Following a violent raid on her outpost, a British nurse, Anne is on the run with a small group of soldiers. She must balance bravery with compassion to save a native girl, her husband, and her colony.

programme.title: Locked In
programme.desc: A single mother must protect her daughter and herself during a heist gone wrong at a high-tech storage facility.

programme.title: What You Wish For
programme.desc: A down-on-his-luck chef with gambling problems flees to a Latin American villa to join a team of chefs who cook for the super rich. He soon gets more than he bargained for when he discovers the dark secrets of his employer's unique and dangerous culinary appetite

programme.title: Any Bullet Will Do
programme.desc: Two Brothers find themselves on opposing sides of the fight as one hopes to help abolish slavery while the other believes it is his God-given right.

programme.title: Centigrade
programme.desc: A married couple find themselves trapped in their frozen vehicle after a blizzard and struggle to survive amid plunging temperatures and unforeseen obstacles.

programme.title: Hospitality
programme.desc: A woman with a checkered past must protect her son when a man brings trouble to her isolated bed and breakfast.

programme.title: Chosen Family
programme.desc: Ann (Heather Graham) is a yoga teacher struggling to achieve inner peace despite the fact her family is driving her crazy and her dating life is miserable.

programme.title: The Competition
programme.desc: Mauldin (Thora Birch) is a strong-willed but misguided young woman who encourages her millions of blog followers to apply her scientific formula to all relationships in order to prevent heartache.

programme.title: Gold
programme.desc: A South African gold mine foreman is unwittingly manipulated by an unscrupulous gang of financiers who want to flood the mine to raise the price of gold on the world market.

programme.title: Blindfire
programme.desc: A police officer who while responding to a violent hostage call, kills the African American suspect only to later learn of his innocence. Sensing this was a set-up, and facing repercussions, he must track down the person responsible while examining his own accountability and the ingrained racism which brought him to this point.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Tormented by his criminal past, Clean attempts a quiet life caring for his community and as a mentor to his young neighbor Dianda. When local gang violence puts his neighbor's life in danger, Clean finds himself returning to his violent past.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away from it all in a remote country house but when a mysterious injured man turns up on their doorstep telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: The Cooler
programme.desc: In an old school Las Vegas casino, its top gambling jinx breaks his curse when he falls in love, much to his boss' consternation.

programme.title: Broken Star [Extended Version]

programme.desc: Evading police at a remote farmhouse after fumbling a robbery, four criminals discover that the family living there is not who they appear to be.

programme.desc: A third-rate British spy is sent to an island, unaware he is there to lure Soviet spies.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns

programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away from it all in a remote country house but when a mysterious injured man turns up on their doorstep telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: The Cooler
programme.desc: In an old school Las Vegas casino, its top gambling jinx breaks his curse when he falls in love, much to his boss' consternation.

programme.title: Broken Star [Extended Version]
programme.desc: Abandoned by her friends and family and with her career in jeopardy, starlet Markey Marlowe is sequestered in a duplex with a reclusive landlord who just may be more dangerous than she is.

programme.title: Operation Sea Wolf
programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.title: Hideout
programme.desc: Evading police at a remote farmhouse after fumbling a robbery, four criminals discover that the family living there is not who they appear to be.

programme.title: The Trouble With Spies
programme.desc: A third-rate British spy is sent to an island, unaware he is there to lure Soviet spies.

programme.title: Sweet Kisses
programme.desc: Who doesn't love Sweet Kisses? Join Chef Kimberly Lallouz as she showers them on her multi-course feast all laid out in One Big Recipe. Her Spicy Cornbread gets the first peck with lip-smacking Honey Butter. Then, it's a berry... nice smooch for a seared rare Duck Breast appetizer with Cherries and Walnuts. Avocado Honeydew Gazpacho follows, silky and savoury, with just a gentle sugary buss from the melon, it's a chilled soup gorgeously garnished with crostini and mascarpone. Citrus smooches Salmon on the main course, butter basted and presented with shattered dried citrus shards sprinkled over top and Basmati with Cranberries and Rice Vinegar alongside. Anyone can do it! It's all in the One Big Recipe.

programme.title: Wow Factor
programme.desc: What sets this cool One Big Recipe by charismatic chef-host Kimberly Lallouz apart? Folks, may I introduce the 'Wow Factor'? It's that hard- to-define special something, but we know it when we see it! Ogle her Chilled Mussels over Grilled Baguette lightly drizzled with vibrant, golden Saffron Aioli. Gasp at the golden gorgeous Roasted Mini Butternuts, ever so very vivacious with their Salsa Verde, tart Goat Cheese, and nutty toasted sunflower seed garnishes. Bone-in Veal Roast with an easy-to-execute and guaranteed-to-wow presentation is the apex of the event, with grainy mustard vinaigrette-dressed Charred Bok Choy halves. Dessert gets a moment in the spotlight, summer berries draped with applause-inspiring vanilla whipped cream and sweet, crunchy Macadamia Streusel.

programme.title: Stuffed Olives and Risotto
programme.desc: Italian host Vanessa Gianfrancesco whips up classy dishes for a gorgeous dinner party in Italy.

programme.title: Izakaya Finger Foods
programme.desc: Every culture has its version of finger food and in Japan it’s called Izakaya! Hana Etsuko Dethlefsen prepares tapas dishes perfect for nighttime snacking.

programme.title: Spencer's Holiday BBQ
programme.desc: Join charismatic chef Spencer Watts at his glorious rooftop patio for a one-hour special featuring a full holiday spread, all made on the BBQ. Spencer’s festive menu is all about creative BBQ twists with his delectable, mouth-watering recipes including Burnt Orange Cranberry Marmalade, Maple Rye Pumpkin Pie, and Asparagus with Smoked Salmon Dip. Save room for the piece de Q-sistance: Smoked Turkey Two Ways. This year, take your holiday feast outside and serve up something deliciously different.

programme.title: Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Get your 'Gobble Gobble' on with this special episode of Holiday Eatz, featuring fun and charming host Kimberly Lallouz! She starts her terrific Turkey Day menu with a harvest happy Kale Salad heaped with beets, candied pecans, toasted lentils, and goat cheese. Thanksgiving dinner needs Hot Rolls, Chef Lallouz packs hers with cranberries and corn, then serves them as a standalone course with a cheesy, creamy Mushroom Fondue! Next, it's time to talk turkey with a trick that cuts your poultry cooking time in half! Her Spatchcock Turkey is not just faster than old school, it's yummier too, with a garlic-herb marinade and a unique side of mixed beans and rice! Candied sweet potatoes and marshmallows make their perennial appearance here, but Chef Kimberly has a version that will fry"... your brain! Check out her Sweet Potato Churros with Marshmallow Creme for a presentation you"... do-nut"... want to miss!

programme.title: Pies Galore
programme.desc: In preparation for a relaxing holiday with friends and family, FLOUR POWER THANKSGIVING: PIES GALORE invites you into the kitchen to bring a twist to your Thanksgiving classics. In this holiday special, host Jessica McGovern takes us through three new and exciting treats to bring to your table, sharing some of her favourite tips and tricks along the way. Jessica offers up three alternatives to a standard Thanksgiving dessert - serving up light and flaky Pie Fries with Apple Caramel Dip, a rich and creamy Sweet Potato Pie, and a luscious Vanilla Bourbon Sweet Potato Pie Cake coated in a fluffy marshmallow frosting. These quick and easy recipes will put you in the holiday spirit while adding a new taste to classic desserts.

programme.title: Classics with a Twist
programme.desc: When planning a multi-course dinner for six, we all think 'go with the classics' and so does sassy chef-host Kim Lallouz. For her, however, it's Classics... with a Twist! Use the One big Recipe and cook along as Bread and Butter gets a smoke, honey, herb, and black sea salt makeover. Next, Shrimp Cocktail is reinvented with a horseradish kick in her Apricot Ketchup. Then, it's Potato Pave as a standalone course, garnished with tangy tarragon crÃ¨me fraiche and briny salmon roe. Prime Rib is as classic as it comes, but with a sous-vide twist and truffle-spiked Pea and Lardon salad, plan to drop everything so you can twist along! For a sweet ending, dress up dessert from your favourite bakery with a cool trick for making easy lavender ice cream. Dinner is love, and you will love this dinner!

programme.title: Tapas Party!
programme.desc: Re-join Chef Kimberly Lallouz in her One Big Recipe test kitchen as she masterfully creates a week night feast of cheesy polenta and red pepper pesto, creamy paprika shrimp, curried lamb lollipops, salmon ceviche, and Korean kimbap.

programme.title: Turf N' Surf
programme.desc: Re-join Chef Kimberly Lallouz in her One Big Recipe test kitchen as she masterfully creates a week night feast of venison tartare, whole roasted maitake mushroom with a trio of sauces, seared scallops with a pea and fava bean puree and pepper relish, and a dandelion salad.

programme.title: BLITZ'N
programme.desc: Get ready for a special holiday BLITZ! with master mixologist Yvonne Langen as she prepares her favorite holiday cocktails and party snacks in the Gusto TV kitchen!

programme.title: The Wizard of Whatever: Holiday Edition
programme.desc: Gusto TV’s Wizard of Whatever, Chef Kyle Crawford, is dishing up a holiday feast! There’ll be food, fun, elves… and even jolly old St. Nick himself may make an appearance! Join in as Kyle cooks up a Christmas goose complete with stuffing and gravy, plus all the sides and salads, and even a flashy flambé dessert! Merry whatever!

programme.title: Twists on the Classics
programme.desc: Christmas is right around the corner and it calls for a little fun - like a twist on traditional holiday desserts! FLOUR POWER CHRISTMAS: TWISTS ON THE CLASSICS offers a new take on some of your favourites to bring you a fresh perspective and world of flavour for the holidays! Enchanting host Jessica McGovern plays off classic desserts, serving up handy hints on how to get the most out of every bite. From sweet and fluffy Gumdrop Cakes drizzled with a light lemony glaze to a delectable Eggnog Ski Slope Cake decorated with rosemary trees and a few friends to hit the hills, Jessica's unique holiday recipes will surly make it on your list of Christmas traditions!

programme.title: One World Kitchen: Our Favourite Holiday Recipes
programme.desc: In this special holiday episode of One World Kitchen, Hana (Japan), Vanessa (Italy), Natalia (Argentina), and Pailin (Thailand) get together to cook their favorite traditional holiday dishes influenced by their respective cultures. Christmas Sushi Rolls, Veal in a Creamy Tuna Sauce with Capers, Striped Bass in Garlic and Lime Marinade, and an epic Timballo. For the final recipe, our hosts combine all the flavors of One World Kitchen into a truly internationally-inspired turkey dish.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italian Christmas
programme.desc: BONACINI'S ITALIAN CHRISTMAS is a heartwarming one-hour holiday special featuring celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini as he shares some of his favourite Italian Christmas Eve dishes. Michael invites us to the set of his series "Bonacini's Italy" to cook up traditional Italian fare like Salt Cod Mousse on Polenta Crostini and Pork Braised in Milk. Michael takes us on a holiday culinary journey as he explores homey Christmas flavours and traditions, offering tips for perfecting dishes from the regions of Veneto, Sardinia, Calabria, Sicily, and Emilia Romagna.

programme.title: Big Wow Desserts
programme.desc: The holidays are here! And the holidays come with a lineup of treats you won't be able to resist! From sweet and salty to traditional and unconventional, FLOUR POWER CHRISTMAS: BIG WOW DESSERTS covers it all. To get in the holiday spirit, enchanting host Jessica McGovern introduces two desserts that could impress any Scrooge. First, Jessica bakes a decadent Chocolate Yule Log stuffed with a creamy Salted Caramel Frosting and finishes with a holiday-inspired cake decorated with homemade peppermint candy canes! Interwoven with tricks of the trade, Jessica guides us through her simple yet inspiring treats that are perfect for a big Christmas celebration.

programme.title: Spencer's BIG Holiday
programme.desc: No matter how you celebrate the holidays, let Spencer Watts help you plan the menu, in SPENCER’S BIG HOLIDAY! In this festive one-hour holiday special, Spencer Watts is serving up some of his favourite holiday meals, treats, and drinks. Follow Spencer as he shows us how to sail through the hectic holiday season with style, from brunch to the moment the clock strikes midnight.

programme.title: Maddie and Kiki's Holiday BBQ Barn
programme.desc: Fun-loving sisters and expert grillmasters Maddie and Kiki welcome you into their country barn to celebrate the holidays! They’re making a full menu of festive dishes on the BBQ – plus some drinks to get you in the party mood!

programme.title: Edible Gifts
programme.desc: Christmas is near, and the pressure is on! Between work, home, friends, and family, the list of people to buy for is endless. To help us through this busy time, FLOUR POWER CHRISTMAS: EDIBLE GIFTS offers up four creative and more personal options to make the holidays cheaper, sweeter, and filled with love. Fun host Jessica McGovern shows us how to bake something for everyone including Crispy Brittle Bark covered in chocolate, rich Coal Cookies that are sweet with a bit of heat, adorable peanut butter-chocolate Reindeer Cupcakes, and easy-to-make Christmas Puzzle Cookies.

programme.title: Popular Athens Recipes
programme.desc: Greek home cook Joanna Chery kicks off this episode of One World Kitchen by showcasing popular recipes from Athens. She begins by preparing Chicken Souvlaki with Tzatziki, a classic dish featuring succulent, beautifully charred chicken skewers and a refreshing cucumber yogurt garlic dipping sauce. Next, she fries up some deliciously flaky cod with an irresitble garlic-potato dip, a staple recipe for Greece's Independence Day. Another popular dish in the Greek culture is Lamb Fricassee. It includes crispy, browned lamb pieces, juicy beef stock and a lovely egg - so savoury! Don't forget, we need a perfect dessert to follow a rich and hearty lamb dish: fried dough balls. Joanna shows us her tricks for making them perfectly warm and crispy.

programme.title: Olives: The Most Useful Ingredient
programme.desc: Is there anything more Greek than olives? Host Joanna Chery shows us how versatile the olive really is by cooking up four diverse Greek dishes. To start, a rich, baked-to-perfection Olive Bread loaded with strong, slightly fruity black Kalamata olives. She then prepares a refreshing Greek Village Salad full of seasonal vegetables, creamy feta, and plump juicy olives tossed in extra virgin olive oil. And guess what? It pairs great with fried Olive Bread! Then, Joanna switches it up with wonderful green olives - the star in her delicious stuffing for Apricot and Feta-Stuffed Chicken Thighs. Finally, we're graced with a unique dessert - Saint Fanourios Cake. Joanna adds metaxa (Greek brandy), sweet dried apricots, and luscious olive oil for a moist dessert.

programme.title: Canada + Greece
programme.desc: From Canada to Greece, CombiNATION Plates always covers lots of ground! Kicking off, host Bianca Osbourne wows with ubERS-Canadian Roasted Venison Loin, yummy Fiddlehead Pancakes and sweet-tart Cranberry sauce. Next, enjoy a scenic Mediterranean vacation on a plate with her completely new approach to Greek Salad, taken up a notch or two with tasty seared Albacore Tuna! This episode's 'common ingredient' is lamb shank; check out two wildly creative re- inventions; first, of Canadian TourtieÌ€re, and then, Greek Dolmades. For a final recipe, a dessert fit for a lumberjack or a Greek god! Oka Saganaki with McIntosh Apple Butter and Maple Loukoumades; made with nutty Canadian Oka cheese, fried crisp, flambeÌed with Ouzo, then dusted with dried raspberry powder and maple sugar flakes. 'Opa!' meets Oka!

programme.title: Hearty Greek Fare
programme.desc: Winters in Greece can get chilly, so fun host Joanna Chery warms us up with some hearty Greek dishes. First, she rolls up some tender Meatballs in a Lemon-Egg Sauce featuring a secret ingredient: rice (shh!). Then, she cooks a vegetarian stew that's packed with tasty artichokes, soft-boiled potatoes, and fragrant dill - great for a cool spring night. To finish, she makes a famous Greek dish called Moussaka. Traditionally eaten at Sunday dinner, this dish emulates the warmth of friends and family. Although it's a two part process - it's packed with layered vegetables, a hearty meat sauce and a creamy béchamel on top - it's so worth it!

programme.title: Leaves and Lettuces
programme.desc: Chef Pino Di Cerbo leaves no leaf behind in this exciting episode! Things kick off with a fresh salad full of crunchy cabbage and kale, topped with a mango vinaigrette. Then Pino gets wild with dolmades, grape leaves stuffed with wild rice and sweet caramelized onions. Next-up, French fries get friendly with foliage, served with a pile of fried herbs and homemade herb mayo for dipping. In his final creation, Pino reaches for the rainbow...of Swiss chard, that is! The colourful leaves get layered over creamy gorgonzola and puff pastry for a tart that will have you going back for more!

The narrative underscores the community spirit and the joy of sharing delicious food at live events.

programme.desc: Who doesn't love Sweet Kisses? Join Chef Kimberly Lallouz as she showers them on her multi-course feast all laid out in One Big Recipe. programme.title: Wow Factor
programme.desc: What sets this cool One Big Recipe by charismatic chef-host Kimberly Lallouz apart? Folks, may I introduce the 'Wow Factor'? Gasp at the golden gorgeous Roasted Mini Butternuts, ever so very vivacious with their Salsa Verde, tart Goat Cheese, and nutty toasted sunflower seed garnishes. Bone-in Veal Roast with an easy-to-execute and guaranteed-to-wow presentation is the apex of the event, with grainy mustard vinaigrette-dressed Charred Bok Choy halves. Dessert gets a moment in the spotlight, summer berries draped with applause-inspiring vanilla whipped cream and sweet, crunchy Macadamia Streusel.

programme.title: LIVEFEED Bluesfest Part 1
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of Oxbury, Ontario, the Giant Pig Smokehouse opened in 2019, bringing Southern barbecue to life. The journey began in 2018 on Melissa's 30th birthday during a trip to Mexico when her brother proposed the idea of opening a restaurant. Embracing their love for smoked foods and recognizing the local events like Vankleek Hill Fair and Rib Fests, they decided to share their culinary passion beyond their home.nnThe Giant Pig Smokehouse offers a variety of Southern barbecue dishes, with pulled pork poutine and brisket poutine being top sellers. Their pulled pork is described as sweet, saucy, and flavorful, often served in sandwiches or on poutines. The authenticity of their poutin gravy, made with meat drippings, is a highlight for many patrons.nnCustomers praise the establishment for its delicious food and the welcoming atmosphere. Bianca from Gatineau, who tried the brisket poutine, found it amazing and fulfilling. McKenna and Matt from Alberta and Stoweville, Ontario, also shared their positive experiences, highlighting the quality of the barbecue and the friendly service.nnThe owners emphasize the importance of patience in barbecue, advocating for slow cooking and marination to achieve the best flavors. They share their journey from backyard barbecues to a full-fledged restaurant, driven by their love for barbecue and the joy of sharing their creations with others.nnWorking with family has its challenges and rewards. While the bond and trust are invaluable, there are moments of bickering that can be mistaken for conflict by customers. Despite these moments, the family's dedication to their craft and to each other shines through.nnThe Giant Pig Smokehouse is not just a restaurant; it's a family business where love and dedication are infused into every dish. The secret to their success lies in the love and flavor they put into their food, ensuring every meal is as cherished as if it were served to their own family.

programme.title: Sweet Kisses
programme.desc: Who doesn't love Sweet Kisses? Join Chef Kimberly Lallouz as she showers them on her multi-course feast all laid out in One Big Recipe. Her Spicy Cornbread gets the first peck with lip-smacking Honey Butter. Then, it's a berry... nice smooch for a seared rare Duck Breast appetizer with Cherries and Walnuts. Avocado Honeydew Gazpacho follows, silky and savoury, with just a gentle sugary buss from the melon, it's a chilled soup gorgeously garnished with crostini and mascarpone. Citrus smooches Salmon on the main course, butter basted and presented with shattered dried citrus shards sprinkled over top and Basmati with Cranberries and Rice Vinegar alongside. Anyone can do it! It's all in the One Big Recipe.

programme.title: Wow Factor
programme.desc: What sets this cool One Big Recipe by charismatic chef-host Kimberly Lallouz apart? Folks, may I introduce the 'Wow Factor'? It's that hard- to-define special something, but we know it when we see it! Ogle her Chilled Mussels over Grilled Baguette lightly drizzled with vibrant, golden Saffron Aioli. Gasp at the golden gorgeous Roasted Mini Butternuts, ever so very vivacious with their Salsa Verde, tart Goat Cheese, and nutty toasted sunflower seed garnishes. Bone-in Veal Roast with an easy-to-execute and guaranteed-to-wow presentation is the apex of the event, with grainy mustard vinaigrette-dressed Charred Bok Choy halves. Dessert gets a moment in the spotlight, summer berries draped with applause-inspiring vanilla whipped cream and sweet, crunchy Macadamia Streusel.

programme.title: LIVEFEED Bluesfest Part 1
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of Oxbury, Ontario, the Giant Pig Smokehouse opened in 2019, bringing Southern barbecue to life. The journey began in 2018 on Melissa's 30th birthday during a trip to Mexico when her brother proposed the idea of opening a restaurant. Embracing their love for smoked foods and recognizing the local events like Vankleek Hill Fair and Rib Fests, they decided to share their culinary passion beyond their home.nnThe Giant Pig Smokehouse offers a variety of Southern barbecue dishes, with pulled pork poutine and brisket poutine being top sellers. Their pulled pork is described as sweet, saucy, and flavorful, often served in sandwiches or on poutines. The authenticity of their poutin gravy, made with meat drippings, is a highlight for many patrons.nnCustomers praise the establishment for its delicious food and the welcoming atmosphere. Bianca from Gatineau, who tried the brisket poutine, found it amazing and fulfilling. McKenna and Matt from Alberta and Stoweville, Ontario, also shared their positive experiences, highlighting the quality of the barbecue and the friendly service.nnThe owners emphasize the importance of patience in barbecue, advocating for slow cooking and marination to achieve the best flavors. They share their journey from backyard barbecues to a full-fledged restaurant, driven by their love for barbecue and the joy of sharing their creations with others.nnWorking with family has its challenges and rewards. While the bond and trust are invaluable, there are moments of bickering that can be mistaken for conflict by customers. Despite these moments, the family's dedication to their craft and to each other shines through.nnThe Giant Pig Smokehouse is not just a restaurant; it's a family business where love and dedication are infused into every dish. The secret to their success lies in the love and flavor they put into their food, ensuring every meal is as cherished as if it were served to their own family.

programme.title: LIVEFEED Bluesfest Part 2
programme.desc: Golden Fries, a food truck venture founded by Jesse Teasdale and his wife, has become a popular spot at Bluesfest Ottawa. The menu highlights a classic poutine, made with fresh-cut fries, squeaky cheese curds, and rich gravy, as its top-selling item. The video captures various attendees raving about the quality and taste of the food, emphasizing the truck's commitment to using local, high-quality ingredients. Additionally, the video showcases the preparation and dedication that goes into running the truck, from early morning setups to handling large orders for bands and their crews. The narrative underscores the community spirit and the joy of sharing delicious food at live events.

programme.title: Montreal Greek
programme.desc: Most Canadians think salad & souvlaki when they think Greek food. Uh uh, no way. We uncover true Greek noshing in Montreal's Parc Ex district. Our day begins at the crack of dawn in a Greek fish market unloading fresh catches just flown in from the Mediterranean. Then we go to a Greek baker for a primer on Greek bread. Next, we're at a Greek rotisserie for an entire lamb cooked on the spit, and finally to Milo's, a Montreal dining tradition for 30 years for a Greek seafood feast.

programme.title: L'eau à la Bouche
programme.desc: The overlooked condiment. To the Laurentians we journey to L'Eau à La Bouche (French for "mouth watering"), a lovely little Inn & restaurant in the town of St. Adèle.. The special menu they have conjured up for us is all honey. We've found a supplier who makes 5 different honeys including a knock-your-socks-off wild mint honey. They also distill mead, the ancient nectar made from honey and water. Later, we pop off to the local orchards for fruit for the sauces at dinner that night at the Inn.

programme.title: Les Fougères
programme.desc: To the beautiful foothills of the Gatineau Park we travel to Les Fougères restaurant. There, a wonderful husband and wife team are redefining traditional Quebec cuisine with a modern twist including venison & goat's cheese tourtiere, split pea soup with pear juice and smoked haddock. We also visit an artisan goat's cheese maker and find out how two married people can work together side by side in the pressure cooker of a kitchen without killing each other.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Students of Kelas 3 Merah agreed to assist Mrs Jojie and Mrs. Zack in a mission to save Mr Blond and turned out that Cikgu M was a con artist.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: The English teacher’s method is too strict and ineffective. She has poor grasp of the language and very unqualified. She teaches the class the wrong pronunciations. Cikgu Joji the BM teacher replaces her and becomes the English and BM teacher. She can’t handle the workload and stress, and she mixes up the two subjects in one class. Encik Yusof, the Assistant Principal, brings in a new English teacher to the class…

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Introduction of the new teacher, James Blond. The students introduce themselves in terrible English, and prove to be a whole new challenge for James Blond.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: The students, who are now familiar with the nice and soft-spoken Mr. James Blond, take advantage of that. James Blond has trouble controlling the class. He turns to Cikgu Joji for advice. Cikgu Joji teaches him to be firm and tough on them (and also explore the differences of British and Malaysian schools). James Blond becomes too tough, punishing the kids for small mischiefs and mistakes. In the end, Cikgu Joji makes him realize of his errors. He apologizes to the students. Even though what he did was wrong, he now has the respect and fear of the students and he can control them better.
